'''Zolanese''' was the native [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Zolander]]s, who established it as the native tongue of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Zolan/Legends|Zolan]]. The language [[Clawdite (language)/Legends|Clawdite]] was a modified form of Zolanese.<ref name="scum" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zolanese was first mentioned in [[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']], a [[2008]] sourcebook for the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook|''Saga Edition'']] of the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] on [[November 18]], [[2008]].<ref name="scum" />
